scenario: Next GM after the P-31 note: support, cites P-31.

output.headline: This fits the exception the treasurer set for recruiting GMs on P-31.

reasons.text: On P-31 the treasurer approved the last recruiting GM above the usual rate and set a higher per-head ceiling for recruiting GMs, since walk-ins beat RSVPs. At [[S-per-head]] per RSVP, this request sits under that ceiling.
That note is newer than C-02 and C-03, so it reads as an exception for recruiting GMs rather than a change for regular ones.
Approving still leaves [[S-above-reserve-after]] above the C-04 reserve, with [[S-events-left]] GMs on the calendar.
